title: Lumite

fields.label: Island
fields.value: River Cave, Finlay, Ferwater, Acid Wastes

body:
Description


Lumite is a vibrant, fluorescent green ore found in Prismarine nodes in the caves of the River Biome.

Raw Lumite can be sold for Lumite Credits in the River Shop at a rate of 1 piece for 1 credit. These credits can be used to buy various items that aid in harvesting more Lumite. There is no minimum size requirement for exchanging Raw Lumite into credits.

To mine Lumite, you need a refined pickaxe or greater. Industrial Refineries and Industrial Forges are required to process it.

Trivia

  • Lumite used to not be exchanged for credits in small or chiseled pieces.
  • Lumite can not be exchanged for credits in its forged or refined variant.
  • Lumite needs to be refined and forged by Industrial Refinery and Industrial Forge
  • Lumite used to have a sell value of $570, making it one of the best ores to farm in-game.
